Coordination_geometry.description: The spatial arrangement of atoms or ligands around the central metal atom, describing the geometric configuration of coordination sites (e.g., octahedral, tetrahedral, square planar).

Crystallinity.description: The degree to which the material possesses a long-range ordered crystal structure, typically confirmed by techniques such as PXRD or SAED.

Topological_structure.description: The underlying network connectivity or topology of the framework, defined by node and linker arrangement (e.g., hcb, sql, dia).

Porosity_BET_surface_area.description: The specific surface area of the material determined by BET analysis, reflecting the accessible pore surface area (m²/g).

Pore_size_shape_volume.description: The size, shape, and total pore volume of the material’s pores as determined from gas adsorption or other porosity measurements.

Defects.description: The presence or absence of structural imperfections such as vacancies, missing linkers, or intentionally introduced defects.

Morphological_characteristics.description: The overall morphology and particle shape of the material observed via microscopy (e.g., nanosheets, nanorods, spheres).

Semiconductor.description: Indicates whether the material exhibits semiconducting behavior and its type (e.g., p-type or n-type).

Particle_Size_Nanosheet_Thickness.description: The average particle dimensions or nanosheet thickness as measured by microscopy or AFM.

Layer_Stacking_Mode.description: The stacking arrangement between adjacent layers in layered materials (e.g., AA, AB, or staggered).

Pi_Conjugation.description: Describes the extent of π-electron delocalization within the framework that contributes to its electronic and optical properties.

Hydrogen_Bonding.description: Information on the presence and type of hydrogen bonding interactions within or between framework layers.

Hydrophilicity_Hydrophobicity.description: The wettability or affinity of the material’s surface toward water or other polar solvents, indicating hydrophilic or hydrophobic character.

Light_absorption_range.description: The wavelength range of light absorbed by the material, typically determined from UV–Vis spectroscopy.

Band_Gap_band_structure_band_position.description: The electronic band gap energy and relative positions of valence and conduction bands, obtained from optical or electrochemical measurements.

Oxidation_reduction_Potential_HOMO_LUMO_.description: The absolute energy levels of the HOMO and LUMO or redox potentials, referenced to vacuum or standard electrodes.

Light_Harvesting_Light_Adsorption.description: The material’s efficiency in absorbing and utilizing incident light for photoactive processes.

Photoluminescence.description: The emission characteristics of the material when excited by light, including emission wavelength or spectral features.

Photoluminescence_Quantum_Yield_PLQY.description: The ratio of emitted photons to absorbed photons, expressed as a percentage of photoluminescence efficiency.

Fluorescence_Phosphorescence_lifetime.description: The time-resolved lifetime of excited-state emission, indicating fluorescence or phosphorescence decay times.

Ionization_potential.description: The energy required to remove an electron from the material’s valence band or HOMO, usually measured in electron volts (eV).

Electronic_structure.description: Describes the distribution and transitions of electronic states within the material, including bandgap type and orbital transitions.

Donor_Acceptor_effect.description: Information on electron-donating and -accepting moieties within the framework that influence charge transfer properties.

Charge_induced_effect.description: Observations of charge separation or accumulation effects under photoexcitation or external stimuli.

Ionization_effect.description: Information on the material’s stability and response to ionization or photoionization under light exposure.

Excited_state_lifetime.description: The lifetime of the excited electronic state obtained from time-resolved spectroscopic measurements.

Stability_Thermal_Chemical_Photostabilit.description: Describes the material’s resistance to thermal, chemical, or photochemical degradation under various conditions.
